## Projects
- Seravel — Lancashire Digital's own measurement instrument behind the AI Answer Audit. Sends reproducible questions to AI systems, compares answers to approved references, reports visibility and accuracy rates and traces errors to their likely source. In beta, expanded system by system.

## Verified facts
- KI-Antwort-Audit (AI Answer Audit): Powered by Seravel. Measures whether AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google Gemini) describe a company and its products correctly, against the client's own approved sources. Two weeks, repeated runs, rates not impressions, each run archived as a baseline. Fixed prices: free Snapshot; Audit CHF 7'500; Audit Regulated CHF 15'000; Monitoring CHF 950 per month. Target groups: pharma, medtech, finance and other regulated industries.
- Assessment: Fixed price after the initial call, two to three weeks. A prioritised basis for decision, including a clear recommendation on what to stop or correct.
- Fractional CDO mandate: One to four days a month, six-month minimum term (full-time on request). First the decision (business case with baseline, commission-free vendor choice, an owner from the client's team); then execution of vendors, milestones and sign-offs through to go-live; ends with the handover.

- SaaS & Regulatory Tech: Executive leadership of SaaS providers and digital product passports under the EU Ecodesign regulation (Transpareo AG).
